Question: Why is the distinction between scheduling policy and scheduling mechanism useful in CPU scheduling design?
Option1: It allows the implementation mechanisms to remain stable while the policy determining which process should run can be changed independently
Option2: Policy and mechanism must always be identical
Option4: Policies cannot be changed
CorrectAnswer: It allows the implementation mechanisms to remain stable while the policy determining which process should run can be changed independently
Explanation: Separating policy from mechanism makes operating system design more modular and allows different scheduling strategies to use common implementation mechanisms.
